current_date: February 2026 (cover page; inner item tables from p.9 are still footed 'February 2024')
current_evidence: The workbook PDF's cover is dated February 2026 and supersedes the February 2024 list (media/14294) and the 2023 draft consulted to 31 Jan 2024; searches of eastleigh.gov.uk found no later version, although the council's planning pages do not link any list directly.

issues.detail: The List date value (Feb 2026) is right, but Grokbot took it from PDF metadata (CreationDate) and not from the document text. The cover text says 'February 2026'. Inner pages from p.9 onward are footed 'February 2024', so the 2026 list is largely the 2024 tables republished. The workbook should record that.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'February 2026'; item tables footed 'Local List for Validation of Planning Applications | February 2024'; Date basis = 'PDF metadata CreationDate'

issues.detail: Most tab_items are sourced from the superseded February 2024 list (media/14294/local-validation-list-2024.pdf) and the old generic validation-criteria-guidance-a4.pdf, not from the 2026 list. Two items appear twice, once from each version: the 'do not scale' disclaimer rule and the 'reserve the right to request hard copies' paragraph.
issues.evidence: tab_items sources: 17 of 22 = media/14294 or media/3170; duplicate text with '| February 2024 |' and '| February 2026 |'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' tab_items are not validation requirements. They include GDPR/personal-data guidance, Planning Portal and hard-copy submission instructions, the council's right to request hard copies, the Article 12 procedure for disputed requirements, and policy-driver citations picked up as rows (IAQM 'Planning for Air Quality' 2017, Biodiversity SPD 2009, AOA Advice Note 3 on wildlife hazards). Two 'Drawing standards' rows are text from diagram labels.
issues.evidence: 'Scale bar & north arrow 31 29 27 25 STREET NAME STREET NAME 23 21 19 17 LOCATION PLAN 4 VALIDATION CRITERIA GUIDANCE SITE PLAN'

issues.detail: All four Householder rows come from the generic validation-criteria-guidance-a4.pdf, not the local list. Their triggers are diagram-label text ('CRITERIA GUIDANCE SITE PLAN', 'ROOF PLAN 7 VALIDATION CRITERIA GUIDANCE ...'). The parking row quotes car parking standards ('Up to 3 bedroom house 2 parking spaces'), which are a design standard, not a validation trigger.

Householder is missing the local requirements that the 2026 list applies to it: item 6 Biodiversity Checklist and Photographs (Householder named); item 7 Ecological Surveys and Assessment (Householder named); item 48 Volume Calculations (residential extensions or replacement dwellings in the Old Bursledon Special Policy Area, Policy BU7); item 18 Heritage Statement (affects a listed building, or a site in or adjacent to a Conservation Area); item 46 Tree Survey/AIA/TPP/AMS (trees or hedgerows removed or affected); item 30 Parking Provision Details (additional need for parking or loss of parking).
issues.evidence: Item 6: 'Required for the following types of applications: Householder applications, Full planning applications, Outline planning applications'; Item 48: 'All residential extensions or replacement dwellings in the Old Bursledon Special Policy Area'

issues.detail: Fourteen local list items are not captured under any application type: 1 Access standards for new dwellings (any proposal creating new dwellings, DM29); 3 Agricultural Development and Diversification Statement (new agricultural buildings or farm diversification); 4 Air Quality Assessment (development that could harm air quality, especially in or near AQMAs); 9 Bird Hazard Assessment/Management Plan (where needed to limit bird attraction affecting Southampton Airport); 10 Draft CEMP/Construction Traffic Management Plan (all major development, plus works affecting watercourses, habitats or adjoining sites); 16 Gypsies, Travellers and Travelling Showpeople supporting statement (new pitches/plots); 22 Lighting Assessment (any floodlighting or external lighting); 29 Open Space Plan (all major residential); 34 Public Art Statement (majors identified in the Planning Obligations SPD); 37 Retail and Leisure Impact Assessment (350sqm+ retail or over 2,500sqm leisure outside centres); 38 Site Survey (all new dwellings and all majors, less than 12 months old); 42 Sustainability Report (new dwellings; non-residential over 500sqm); 43 Telecommunications Supplementary Information (mast/antenna applications, including Part 16 prior approval).
issues.evidence: 2026 list Section 3, items 1-48; e.g. Item 42: 'All developments involving the provision of new dwellings. All non-residential developments above 500sqm of floor space measured externally'

issues.detail: Outline is marked '(none) - national requirements only', but the source names Outline in items 6 (Biodiversity Checklist), 7 (Ecological Surveys) and 8 (BNG Strategy), and item 20 says indicative landscaping plans are accepted for Outline. More generally, about 38 rows are placed under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named' even where the list names the types. For example, BNG Strategy is 'Full planning applications, Outline planning applications ... Excludes householder applications', and the Biodiversity Checklist is Householder/Full/Outline.
issues.evidence: Item 8: 'Required for the following types of applications: Full planning applications; Outline planning applications ... Excludes householder applications.'

issues.detail: Several rows take their trigger from a different requirement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' uses the tree item 46 text, and the local list has no schedule-of-works item. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' uses the retail/town-centre sequential test (item 36). 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' uses the Health Impact Assessment trigger ('EIA development and large major development above 200 residential units'), whereas item 12 covers Schedule 1, or Schedule 2 likely to have significant effects. 'Transport Assessment' uses the parking item 30 text. 'Planning Obligations' uses Employment and Skills Plan text. 'Viability Assessment' runs into item 3 Agricultural statement. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' repeats the foul drainage text, whereas item 41 SuDS applies to 'All new residential and commercial development (excluding residential extensions and changes of use)'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot 'Schedule of works' trigger: 'Tree Protection Plan and Arboricultural Method Statement Required for all applications where trees or hedgerows will be removed...'

issues.detail: Many triggers are cut off or replaced by guidance or policy text, so the thresholds are lost. Affordable Housing should be 10+ dwellings, or a 0.5ha site capable of 10+. Flood Risk Assessment stops at 'is required for:'; the source gives 1ha+ in FZ1 or a critical drainage area, all new development in FZ2/3, and other cases. Landscaping ('Required for applications whereby:'), Marketing Report ('Required in the following circumstances:') and Odour ('Required for:') all stop before their conditions. The Marketing conditions are loss of Class E, community or leisure uses in Eastleigh town or district centres, non-boat uses at River Hamble boatyards/marinas, or loss of employment use. The Odour conditions are food-preparation uses and odorous industrial/commercial uses. BNG reads 'features of geodiversity and soils interest'. SCI is a policy citation, where the source says all major applications. Noise starts with an NDSS URL.
issues.evidence: Grokbot FRA trigger: 'A Flood Risk Assessment is required for: Advice for preparing a Flood Risk Assessment...'

issues.detail: Structural Survey is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' as 'Application type named'. Item 40 applies to works affecting the stability of, or substantial demolition of, listed or locally listed buildings, heritage assets and buildings in conservation areas, and to rural building conversions and demolition where conversion is said to be unfeasible. It is not specific to prior approval, and it is missing from Listed building consent. Item 43 Telecoms, which explicitly covers Part 16 prior approval, is not placed under prior approval.
issues.evidence: Item 40: 'For development proposals that could affect the stability of, or involve the substantial demolition of a listed building, locally listed building, heritage asset...'

issues.detail: 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is placed under Full planning with the trigger 'colour(s) of illumination (if applicable)', which is Section 2 guidance, while Advertisement consent shows '(none)'. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' is the HBIC Biodiversity Checklist (item 6) mislabelled as a generic form.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger 'Centre (HBIC) checklist must be completed and submitted with every application.'

summary: The workbook link is the current February 2026 list, but the date comes from metadata. Many tab_items come from the superseded 2024 list or are boilerplate. Requirements are dumped under Full planning with garbled or cross-wired triggers, Outline wrongly shows none, and about 14 of the 48 local items (e.g. Air Quality, CEMP, Lighting, Site Survey, Sustainability Report, Volume Calculations) are missing.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
